instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly use the Champagne Gold (#C5A059) as primary action color. Do not use default Tailwind blue/indigo.
Import Google fonts: Tiro Bangla and Anek Bangla. Map them correctly in Tailwind config.
Use framer-motion for page entrances and hover states.
For the Before/After slider, use react-compare-slider or build a custom framer-motion slider.

Ensure the hero image has a subtle white/gold gradient overlay to make dark text readable, OR a dark gradient overlay if using white text. Given the light theme, use a semi-transparent white/champagne wash over the hero image.
Add 'data-testid' to ALL interactive elements (buttons, nav links, admin forms, tabs).
Admin panel must be mobile-responsive. Hide sidebar on mobile behind a hamburger.
Never use placeholders (via.placeholder.com). Use ONLY the image URLs provided in media section.
Gallery should use 'columns-1 md:columns-2 lg:columns-3' for true masonry, not just grid.
